phase_gate_law.ready: Only explicit fully supported evidence may claim ready. Any remaining proof gap must demote the phase to blocked or waiting_review.
phase_gate_law.partial_ready: Partial readiness is legal only with durable caveats and a declared unlock policy that either keeps the phase in review or unlocks specific downstream phases with caveats attached.
phase_gate_law.blocked: Blocked means downstream unlock is forbidden until evidence or policy changes.
phase_gate_law.waiting_review: Waiting review means the phase is not auto-promotable and must remain operator-visible until reviewed.
phase_gate_law.terminal_outcomes: terminal_success, terminal_failed, and terminal_cancelled close the phase without advertising downstream unlock.

handoff_requirements.evidence_refs: Every unlocking handoff must carry durable evidence refs.
handoff_requirements.caveats: Partial-ready unlocks must keep caveats durable and operator-visible.
handoff_requirements.proof_gaps: Proof gaps may travel through handoff only when the verdict is not full ready.
handoff_requirements.next_decision: Every handoff names the next decision owner, the open question, and the recommended action.
handoff_requirements.evidence_pack_refs: Handoffs may carry compact evidence-pack refs by pack ID, artifact path, fingerprint, and summary; linked pack storage remains authoritative.
